## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `python -m pytest` passes in `scaffold/`
- [ ] `shellcheck weeks/*/check.sh` passes (if scripts changed)
- [ ] Any scanned-host text goes through `md()` / `esc()` (with a hostile-input test)
- [ ] Finding ids unchanged, or the change is noted in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No secrets, real hostnames or personal data in fixtures or docs
- [ ] For a parser change: the real tool output that motivated it is attached (anonymised)
